reviews.x: The Oral B Vitality Dual Clean toothbrush performs like many of the $100+ power brushes but at a fraction of the cost.  I started using mine about a month before my most recent dentist visit and noticed a definite improvement in my brushing results, both above and below the gumline.  Brushing with the Dual Clean takes a little getting used to.  First, it's a different technique than regular brushes - you simply glide the brush along your teeth and gums rather than scrubbing back and forth.  The

I think this toothbrush is not only a bargain, but the best electric toothbrush I have ever used.  Long ago, I spent a fortune on a "sonic" type electric toothbrush which was not nearly as effective in cleaning teeth as this one.  With the round brush going around, and the square brush going back and forth, you can get into crevices and dental work that the plain round brushes simply can't reach.  And it takes up very little real estate on the bathroom counter.  I'm really impressed!

I've  been using this toothbrush for a long time now and am very happy with it.  It has it's own recharger, which is nice and the brush heads are replaceable and inexpensive.  My dentist recommended this one to me and since all my check-ups have  been good, I give the credit to the Oral B Vitality Dual Clean Power Brush. I do floss once a day and use this brush three times a day.I time how long I'm brushing as I don't want to under or overbrush.  I highly recommend this to everyone.

I got tired of feeling plaque buildup with my tongue. I have MS and am wheelchair dependant. Standing to brush 2 minutes is torture. The MS has affected my right and dominant hand. I just can't direct a simple, regular toothbrush effectively.  After my last visit to the dental hygenist, I determined to maintain that clean, smooth feeling! I can't spend $100 on a fancy system, so after reading endless reviews of many brushes, I selected the OralB Vitality-Dual-Head as the best affordable solution

My dentist said I needed a power toothbrush and tried to sell me one for $190.00.  I went online and read all the reviews and felt this toothbrush would be as good as the other expensive one.  They were both Oral B's.  This toothbrush leaves my teeth feel as clean as if the dental hygienist had cleansed my teeth.  The timer is very helpful.  I would recommend this product to anyone.
Excellent toothbrush; the only problem is that the heads wear out very quickly.

reviews.t: Green brush made in Germany, blue brush made in Mexico
reviews.x: Great brush!  I have both, blue and green, and they both work well.  If you're deciding between the two colors, remember that the blue one has a single, round, dentist-tool-like head, and the green one has a regular toothbrush type head.  The only issues are: - It's a NiCd battery which means it'll have the memory effect - If the battery dies, you have to wait at least 8 hours before you can use it, so either keep it charged all the time, or have a backup brush. There are all kind of electric toothbrushes on the market at all kind of prices.  As far as I am concerned this is the best value.  It is economical and does a great job.

I've used an Oral B electric toothbrush for 5 or 6 years now and decided it was time for a new one when I dropped it in a very unfortunate place! When looking for a new one on Amazon I chose the green this time rather than the basic white. It looks great but it just seems a bit sluggish compared to my old one. Also, I enjoyed the two speeds of the older model as well. This one just has one, which again, seems slow.

My old Oral-B's battery gave up the ghost.  I think I had it for about 10 years.  I still had several unused brush heads left over, and was a bit concerned if they would fit on the green model (some reviews here confirmed they would though).  The smaller regular heads do fit.  I assume the brushing action with the smaller head is the same as the blue one's, but not sure. I find the green model's brush head too large. Maybe I'll get used to it. reviews.x: I went from using the previous Oral B with the circular brush only and there is no comparison between that and the dual action brush. Very good upgrade.
